2.264.7
MapViewport.MapLocation
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapViewport.MapLocation element specifies the location of a MapViewport element. The
MapViewport.MapLocation element is optional and is of type MapLocation.
Following is the parent element of the MapViewport.MapLocation element.
Parent elements
MapViewport
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapViewport.MapLocation element.
 <xsd:element name="MapLocation" type="MapLocationType" minOccurs="0" />
